usage: atm-bd console [-h] [--phase PHASE] [--github {graphql,rest,off}]
                      [--interval INTERVAL]
                      [--github-poll-interval GITHUB_POLL_INTERVAL]
                      [--github-quota-threshold GITHUB_QUOTA_THRESHOLD]
                      [--dry-run] [--no-fetch]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --phase PHASE
  --github {graphql,rest,off}
  --interval INTERVAL
  --github-poll-interval GITHUB_POLL_INTERVAL
                        GitHub polling interval in seconds (default 600)
  --github-quota-threshold GITHUB_QUOTA_THRESHOLD
                        minimum remaining quota percentage (default 50)
  --dry-run
  --no-fetch
